issue.title: dispatch.md still names the Agents load: gauge renamed to the cap chip
issue.description: Proposed by phase sase-1om.7 (PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP note #1) of epic sase-1om. The epic's decisions forbade edits to memory notes other than the decisions it selected, so the stale line survived the rename. Landing agent sase-1om.land confirmed it on master a19243cdf6: sase/memory/dispatch.md line 60 says remote load never joins the controller Agents `load:` gauge. The header chip is now `⌂<machine> cap N/M` (src/sase/ace/tui/widgets/agent_load_indicator.py). It always describes the local machine, and on a remote machine tab its tooltip notes that remote capacity is not shown.

task_type_fields.proposed_change: In the Viewer parity notes, replace 'Remote load never joins the controller Agents `load:` gauge, which counts only the controller's own runners.' with 'Remote load never joins the controller Agents `cap` chip (`⌂<machine> cap N/M`), which always describes the local machine's runner capacity, including while a remote machine tab is showing.' Then run sase memory init.

issue.creation_reason: Epic sase-1om's cap-chip phase (sase-1om.7) renamed the gauge but could not edit memory notes; it proposed this correction as a follow-up.
